text: A wetting liquid can rise inside a narrow tube as adhesive and cohesive effects shape its meniscus. For otherwise equal conditions, a narrower tube produces a larger rise.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: OpenStax, College Physics 2e, section 11.8; https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/11-8-cohesion-and-adhesion-in-liquids-surface-tension-and-capillary-action. Consulted 2026-10-13. Independently worded factual explanation; no OpenStax prose is reproduced.

text: The contact angle shows how a liquid meets a solid surface. The balance between adhesion and cohesion can make a drop spread out or bead up.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: OpenStax, College Physics 2e, section 11.8; https://openstax.org/books/college-physics-2e/pages/11-8-cohesion-and-adhesion-in-liquids-surface-tension-and-capillary-action. text: Surface tension tends to reduce a liquid's exposed area. A small object can be supported by the deformed surface even when its material is denser than the liquid.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase.
